newsitem.title: USA: Video Update says same-store sales climbed in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Video Update says same-store sales climbed in Q2.

text.p: Video Update Inc said Monday a seven-percent increase in sales at stores open at least 12 months helped fuel an 89-percent revenue surge in the second quarter.
The company said revenues in the period topped $20 million, up from $10.6 million from the second quarter of fiscal 1996.

Earlier Monday, Video Update said net income in the second quarter was $470,000, or $0.03 a share, down from $486,000, or $0.05 a share a year ago. The earnings reflect the adoption of a more conservative method of amortizing videocassette rental inventory, said the company.
Video Update had 237 company-owned video stores nationwide as of October 31.
